input.title: Two Similar Transfers
input.request: Mira, the account holder, wants H&V to establish whether two similar outgoing transfer entries are one instruction shown twice or two separate instructions, and asks whether the second can be stopped or returned.

events.text: Your payment activity shows two similar outgoing transfer entries to North Quay Utilities for £84.20. One is marked Completed and the other Pending.
I own this account and only meant to make one transfer. Please check whether these are separate instructions, and whether the pending one has been stopped or returned.
I’m checking the count and independent instruction references for Mira’s own payment instructions before advising. I have not cancelled or returned either instruction.

summary: Mira Ellison, writing over secure chat as an unverified customer, asked whether her two transfers are separate instructions and whether the pending one has been stopped or returned. The desk classified it as a question about a transfer, asked the payment system, and closed the case as "wait" because that system's answer had not come back. A second payment lookup was refused because the case was already in the waiting state, no changes were made to the account, and the question about the two transfers is still unanswered, so a person needs to pick the case up, and Mira has not been verified.

content.text:
I've stopped without answering Mira, and her question about the two transfers is still open.

The payment check was refused. The case is in a waiting state, and the desk's rules only allow a payment lookup when the case is triaged. The case also shows that a payment lookup was already requested (`payment_asked=True`), but no result from it is on file.

Because of that, I can't say whether the two £84.20 entries to North Quay Utilities are one instruction shown twice or two separate ones. I also can't say whether the pending one can be stopped or returned.

Mira is also not verified (`verified=False`). Even if the lookup runs, nothing should be disclosed or changed until she has been verified.

I made no changes to the account. The case stays with the desk's waiting state until a person picks it up.
